title: Qwen2.5 Planner ChatML, SFT, and GRPO effect decomposition
research_question: Which part of the current Qwen2.5 pipeline causes the observed routing and stopping behavior: native ChatML formatting, SFT warmup, or GRPO?

hypotheses.H1: Changing the untrained base model from pseudo chat tags to native ChatML reduces tail generation and may change routing score.
hypotheses.H2: SFTv3 improves case-level routing beyond an untrained base model evaluated with the same ChatML prompt.
hypotheses.H3: GRPOv4 improves case-level routing beyond SFTv3 with the same ChatML prompt.

claim_boundary: Development-set causal diagnostic only; no final generalization claim.
